title: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in ListLocksPlugin in Apache JSPWiki 2.10.2 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows an…
description: A Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the ListLocksPlugin of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10.2 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. This flaw allows an attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of a visitor viewing a page that uses the vulnerable plugin. The issue is resolved in version 3.0.1.
